Theorem
[Differentiable Sphere Theorem] 1. ch12:12.40

Let $(M,g)$ be compact and simply connected with dimension $n\geq 4$. If $g$ is strictly pointwise $\frac14$-pinched, then $M$ is diffeomorphic to $S^n$ with its standard smooth structure.

See \cite{Bre10} for a proof.
